environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. Database connection uses a restricted role 'app_reader_v2' provisioned via Terraform aws_db_instance parameter group. The role was created with: CREATE ROLE app_reader_v2 LOGIN PASSWORD '***'; GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE appdb TO app_reader_v2; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_reader_v2; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_reader_v2; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_reader_v2; No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE privileges exist for this role on any table. The TypeORM connection string references this role. Application logs show QueryFailedError on any write attempt but the service continues to serve read endpoints.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_reader_v2
config.database_revokes: REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_reader_v2
config.terraform_resource: aws_db_instance parameter group with pg_hba restricted
config.error_handling: QueryFailedError caught by global exception filter, returns 500
